Former #NFL defensive end Devon Still broke down in tears after seeing his daughter Leah working her FIRST JOB at Chick-fil-A this week.

Leah was diagnosed with cancer as a young child and underwent chemotherapy. During her treatments, she rarely wanted to eat anything unless it was Chick-fil-A.

Now, 12 years later, Leah is cancer-free and has started her first job at the very restaurant that helped her get through those difficult days.

Devon shared that he pulled up to pick her up from work and saw her helping a customer. He immediately became emotional.

“Now I’m sitting in the car with tears pouring down my face.”

Still also revealed that doctors once told him how far Leah’s cancer had spread, and he began accepting the possibility that she might not survive.

“To go from that to this, I can’t explain what I’m feeling. Just know I’m grateful.”

Leah still orders the exact same Chick-fil-A meal she loved during chemotherapy.

THIS IS WHAT LIFE IS ALL ABOUT.

❤️🙏🥹
